name: hud_ui_zrd_widget_ex17c_item_get_mouse_rect_or_bounds
description: HudUiZrdWidgetEx17C_Item::GetMouseRectOrBounds returns the item mouse rectangle when an override is present, otherwise it returns the base ZRD widget bounds.
known_limits: Tier C only; tier S byte comparison is deferred to a coherent HudUiZrdWidgetEx17C item/table pass.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x4b8af0 validates the mouseRectValid read at offset 0x158, returning &mouseRect at offset 0x15c when nonzero, and tailcalling HudUiZrdWidget::GetBoundsRectOrNull otherwise.
The native smoke verifies both the fallback bounds path and the explicit mouse-rect override path.
